statusText: EA_ON / green: Tail remains low while NQ is closed; geopolitical, policy and inflation uncertainty keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the 22:00 UTC Globex reopening is the principal price-structure checkpoint.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress in the final pre-open hour
body: NQ remains closed ahead of the 22:00 UTC Globex reopening. U.S.-China talks are underway without a verified outcome at the cutoff, while Iran/Houthi escalation and inflation concerns keep reopening uncertainty high. Friday's Nasdaq strength was semiconductor-led despite negative breadth, Treasury yields above 5% and oil above $100. No live NQ path yet shows persistent mean-reversion failure.

lookbackSummary: Prior 24 UTC hours: Tail 15-19% and Stress 91-96%; every published slot was green / EA_ON with dominant mode normal.
outlookSummary: NQ remains closed until the 22:00 UTC Sunday reopening. Reopening-gap uncertainty, high rates and geopolitical headlines keep Stress extreme; conditional WATCH is concentrated from reopening through 00:00 UTC, with normalization contingent on two-way price discovery and meaningful retracements.

forecast.analysis: NQ is still closed before the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen. U.S.-China talks remain underway with no verified outcome at the cutoff; Iran/Houthi escalation and inflation concerns keep Stress extreme. With no live price path, Tail stays below WATCH.
drivers: U.S.-China talks have no verified outcome

forecast.analysis: During the second reopening hour, WATCH remains conditional on whether the initial move extends after failed pullbacks. A meaningful retracement or reversal would reduce Tail even if volatility stays high.

forecast.analysis: By 00:00 UTC, WATCH persists only if the opening impulse remains efficient and retracements stay shallow. Two-way discovery, fading volatility or cross-asset stabilization would weaken the Tail case.
drivers: Persistence through the third open hour

forecast.analysis: If reopening develops orderly two-way trade by 01:00 UTC, Tail returns below WATCH while Stress remains extreme. Persistent extension without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate that normalization.
drivers: No-retracement extension is the key invalidation

forecast.analysis: Overnight Tail stays low if price discovery continues to rotate rather than extend one-way. Residual geopolitical and rate uncertainty can keep Stress extreme even with normal retracement behavior.
Low Tail is conditional on continued retracements and absence of repeated directional extension. Stress remains extreme because weekend catalysts can still transmit through energy and rates.
Later overnight conditions favor normalization if the reopening gap has been absorbed and no second directional leg develops. A fresh geopolitical shock would interrupt that path.
drivers: No delayed second leg in base case
Fresh geopolitical shock is an invalidation

forecast.analysis: Before Europe becomes fully active, the base case is lower Stress and low Tail if overnight structure remains two-way. The forecast does not assume future directional continuation.
At the European transition, Tail remains low if cross-asset moves are mixed and NQ keeps retracing. Renewed oil or yield acceleration aligned with NQ would be a risk amplifier.
European liquidity can reprice weekend information. Tail stays low unless NQ, yields and energy begin moving in a mutually reinforcing direction with shallow pullbacks.

With Europe active, the base case remains two-way rather than persistent trend. Stress stays extreme because policy and geopolitical headlines can widen ranges without implying mean-reversion failure.
Approaching the U.S. premarket, Tail remains low if the overnight move has included meaningful retracements. A clean re-acceleration toward session extremes would raise concern.
drivers: Re-acceleration toward extremes is an invalidation

forecast.analysis: Premarket liquidity can amplify the overnight signal. Tail stays below WATCH unless price re-extends with weak pullbacks and cross-assets confirm the same direction.
Two hours before the cash open, the weekend gap should be largely established. Low Tail assumes it has not evolved into persistent one-way structure; Stress remains extreme.
drivers: Weekend gap structure should be clearer
Persistent one-way structure remains the key test

forecast.analysis: Into the late premarket, Tail remains below WATCH if NQ continues to retrace and rotate. Strong directional efficiency into the cash open would be the main upside risk to Tail.
During the cash-open hour, volatility may rise without requiring a Tail block. Tail remains low unless the opening auction produces repeated extension, shallow pullbacks and session-extreme holding.
After the cash-open impulse, the base case falls back toward mixed conditions if retracements appear. Persistent extension after failed pullbacks would keep Tail from normalizing.
Mid-morning Tail remains low if the first cash-session move has not become one-way. Stress stays extreme because yields, oil and geopolitical headlines can still produce large but reversible swings.
Late morning favors normalization if NQ rotates away from extremes and cross-assets stabilize. A delayed second directional leg would be the principal invalidation.
Early afternoon remains low-Tail in the base case if the session has shown meaningful mean reversion. Stress stays extreme because macro and geopolitical uncertainty remain unresolved.
drivers: Meaningful mean reversion in base case
No major scheduled macro release this hour

forecast.analysis: By 18:00 UTC, the base case is lower-Stress and low-Tail if no persistent directional structure has emerged. Any sustained no-retracement move would override this conditional normalization.
drivers: Sustained no-retracement move is the invalidation

forecast.analysis: Into 19:00 UTC, low Tail remains conditional on continued two-way trade and rotation away from extremes. A new aligned oil, yield and NQ extension would be the clearest reason to reassess.
drivers: Aligned oil-yield-NQ extension is the key risk

forecast.analysis: Near the U.S. cash close, low Tail remains conditional on a session that has shown retracements and rotation rather than one-way extension. A power-hour acceleration without meaningful pullbacks would invalidate that base case.
drivers: Meaningful retracements remain the base-case condition

forecastDetail.comment: NQ is still closed; current Tail remains low because no live pathological price-path evidence exists despite extreme headline Stress.
At reopening, WATCH is conditional on gap magnitude, first-retracement depth and cross-asset alignment.
In the second open hour, WATCH depends on whether the first move extends after failed or shallow pullbacks.
By 00:00 UTC, WATCH persists only if the opening impulse remains efficient and meaningful retracements are absent.
By 01:00 UTC, Tail normalizes below WATCH only if reopening structure has become two-way with meaningful retracements.
At 02:00 UTC, low Tail remains conditional on overnight rotation rather than renewed one-way extension.
